# Sirwagya Shekhar

> Sirwagya Shekhar is a Computer Science Engineering student and full stack and AI developer based in Pune, Maharashtra, building AI systems, backend infrastructure, and full stack products.

Sirwagya's portfolio showcases selected software projects, technical interests, and current learning in AI engineering, backend architecture, system design, and Data Structures & Algorithms.

## Portfolio

- [Sirwagya.dev](https://sirwagya.dev/): Personal portfolio, background, selected projects, and current work.

## Projects

- [NEXORA AI](https://github.com/urvashislash/nexora-ai): Team project focused on turning fragmented construction evidence into auditable project intelligence.
- [OnceUponMe Video Engine](https://github.com/Sirwagya/OnceUponMe-Video-Engine): Automated video pipeline for generating personalized cinematic reels from movie footage.
- [Campus Connect](https://github.com/Sirwagya/campus-connect): Full stack campus community and collaboration platform.
- [Crave Check](https://github.com/Sirwagya/Crave-Check): AI-powered food intelligence application with image analysis, personalization, caching, and streaming.
